instrument: CISA/DHS, Post-Quantum Considerations for Operational Technology
what_it_says_about_ot: Recommends OT network segmentation, crypto-agility, prioritising internet-facing edge devices, and starting a PQC plan now; sets no deadline.

instrument: PQCUA (Post-Quantum Cryptography for OPC UA), Horizon Europe proposal (Systerel, Fraunhofer IOSB, Thales and others; OPC Foundation supporting)
what_it_says_about_ot: Research consortium proposal to bring PQC to OPC UA; no OPC Foundation PQC SecurityPolicy published as of the scan.

instrument: CISA, Product Categories for Technologies That Use Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards (under EO 14306)
what_it_says_about_ot: Lists cloud, web, networking, endpoint, collaboration, IAM/PKI/HSM, telecom, computing and enterprise-security categories. States that "operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) devices, are outside the current scope."

instrument: Charter of Trust PQC Working Group, Decrypting the Future: Global Timelines for PQC
what_it_says_about_ot: Names OT among four highest-priority PQC domains; stresses 10-20+ year OT lifetimes and non-upgradable field devices.
